intent_en: To illustrate that while vaccine protection against infection decreases over time, protection against hospitalization remains strong.
previous_intent: To illustrate that while vaccine effectiveness against infection declines over time, protection against hospitalization remains high.
narration_support: You're not fully protected against all infection, but you still have very strong, very long -lived memory B -cell responses that are still there to protect you from severe disease, hospitalization, and death.
chart_support: Line chart showing estimated vaccine effectiveness over time (one to five+ months), where the effectiveness against infection declines significantly while effectiveness against hospitalization remains high and stable.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly contrasts the lack of full protection against infection with strong protection against severe outcomes. The chart visualizes this divergence, showing the infection effectiveness line dropping over several months while the hospitalization effectiveness line stays near the top.
